status: 1.0.0 - adopted in Module 5.2 (2026-10-17); per-requirement team review (review.csv) still pending
method: Roles chosen where O*NET IT occupations have no specific equivalent and at least one independent source describes the role. Skill evidence: R=listed in that role's roadmap.sh roadmap; S=used by >=10% of professional developers (SO 2025); P=listed for that role in a Pakistan in-demand jobs guide; C=named in an official certification outline. importance=essential when evidence comes from >=2 different source types, else optional. Alternatives (e.g. React or Angular) form one requirement satisfied by any member (any_of). Skills must be mapped to Muqayyim skill keys before import; from_onet is computed locally from O*NET software_skills.csv.

sources.S: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, professional developers, >=10% usage
sources.P: Qureos: Most In-Demand Tech Jobs in Pakistan (skills listed per role)
sources.C:AZ400: Microsoft AZ-400 DevOps Engineer study guide, skills measured
sources.C:PMLE: Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer exam guide v4.0
sources.C:GUX: Google UX Design Professional Certificate (Coursera), skills and tools listed
sources.C:GDA: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate (Coursera), skills and tools listed
sources.C:APPLE: Apple Develop in Swift curriculum guide
sources.C:SRE: Google, Site Reliability Engineering book, table of contents (sre.google)
sources.O: O*NET technology skills of the related occupation (computed locally from software_skills.csv; not yet applied)

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Builds the user-facing part of web applications: interfaces, interactivity, performance and accessibility in the browser.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.description: Builds server-side application logic, APIs, data storage and integrations that power web and mobile apps.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.description: Builds complete web applications across frontend, backend, database and deployment.

roles.title: WordPress Developer
roles.description: Builds and maintains websites on WordPress: custom themes, plugins, performance and security.

roles.title: Android Developer
roles.description: Builds native Android apps, from UI and architecture to data storage, testing and Google Play release.

roles.title: iOS Developer
roles.description: Builds native iPhone and iPad apps with Swift, Apple frameworks and App Store distribution.

roles.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Developer
roles.description: Builds apps for Android and iOS from one codebase using Flutter or React Native.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Automates building, testing, deploying and running software: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers and monitoring.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Designs, builds and operates infrastructure on public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.

required_skills.skill: Amazon Web Services (AWS) / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.description: Keeps production systems reliable and fast through monitoring, incident response, automation and capacity planning.

roles.title: DevSecOps Engineer
roles.description: Builds security into the software delivery pipeline: secure CI/CD, container and cloud security, scanning and threat modelling.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds and maintains data pipelines, warehouses and lakes that collect, clean and serve data for analytics and machine learning.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Collects, cleans and analyses data and presents findings through reports and dashboards to support decisions.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Designs, trains, evaluates and deploys machine learning and deep learning models into products.

roles.title: MLOps Engineer
roles.description: Automates training, deployment and monitoring of machine learning models in production.

roles.title: AI Engineer (LLM Applications)
roles.description: Builds applications on top of large language models: prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, evaluation and integration with LLM APIs.

required_skills.skill: OpenAI API / Google Gemini API / Ollama / Hugging Face

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.description: Researches user needs and designs usable, attractive interfaces for web and mobile products, from wireframes to tested prototypes.

roles.title: Product Manager (Software)
roles.description: Decides what a software product should do and why: discovery, roadmap, prioritisation, metrics and working with engineering and design.

roles.title: Game Developer
roles.description: Programs video games: gameplay, physics, graphics and engines, usually with Unity or Unreal Engine.
